description: Held-out evaluation set for OPT-7. These queries were authored AFTER the system was built and are deliberately distinct from evaluations/rag_dataset.json (different phrasings and angles over the same corpus). They are NOT used to tune retrieval, weights, or prompts. Out-of-domain (OOD) cases carry expected_sources=[] and must NOT be answered confidently.
